methodologicalNotes.note: legacy_survey.ts applyInMemory enforces parentSha256/partSha256 and an in-memory bank content hash against its own load, but never checks the recorded bankSha256 (file bytes), stageTopologySha256 or visiblePayloadSha256 against source. The plan records them; an integration seat should enforce bankSha256 and topology as source preconditions. Reviewer verified all three match at 8162724.
Producer loads banks with JSON.parse and validateBankObject default options; the canonical strict sweep uses parseBankText and rejectUnknownKeys:true. Reviewer used the canonical path. Results agree.

Producer's 'changed proposed boundary' control uses a non-resolving string, and 'different resolving primary' is a demonstration that the prefix changes rather than a plan-rejection control. Reviewer added plan-rejection controls for a different valid stage (C10) and a near-identical non-resolving value (C11). C11 matters: a non-resolving primary silently falls back to legacy, so visible-prefix equality alone would pass it, and only exact value equality (and the strict audit's unresolved finding) excludes it.
